question.text: A Category III AIF wishes to change certain terms of its PPM. Within what timeline must it intimate SEBI on a consolidated basis?

answer.text: Within 1 month of the end of each financial year
At the end of the fund tenure

explanation.text: The Logic: Changes in PPM terms are intimated to investors and SEBI on a consolidated basis within 1 month of the end of each financial year, routed through a Merchant Banker with a due diligence certificate. The Trap: 3 months and "at the end of the fund tenure" are not the prescribed consolidated-intimation timelines. The 7-day option also misstates the rule: certain specific PPM changes may be filed directly with SEBI, but the consolidated annual intimation remains within 1 month after financial-year end. Note: Separate timelines apply to other items in the same chapter (for example, the 15-day fee payment for sponsor/manager/control changes), and these should not be conflated with the consolidated PPM-change intimation window.
